name: Trakt
author: Lichtspiel
description: Tells Trakt what each person watches: shows "watching now" on Trakt while a movie or episode plays, adds it to the Trakt history once it is watched, and sends titles marked as watched by hand too. Everyone connects their own Trakt account under Settings and can bring their Trakt history in. Needs a Trakt app: create one at trakt.tv/oauth/applications (redirect URI urn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob) and put its Client ID and Client Secret in the settings below.
